summary: ControlValueAccessor is wired into the four templates and the reactive-form stories compile, but the generator does not install the required @angular/forms runtime dependency and the required behavioral FormControl coverage is absent. Approval is withheld until both are corrected.

findings.title: Install @angular/forms when generating Forms-capable controls
findings.detail: The generated select, checkbox, radio-group, and switch templates import @angular/forms, but config.dependencies omits @angular/forms. A compatible Angular workspace without Forms can therefore run init/add successfully and receive source files that fail to compile. Add the dependency (preserving a consumer-declared compatible version when present) and cover the install plan in the CLI tests.

findings.title: Add executable ControlValueAccessor integration tests
findings.detail: The stage plan requires TestBed coverage for [formControl], formControlName, reset/setValue, touched, disabled composition, invalid input, null handling, user output/change emission, and switch/radio edge cases. This commit adds no component test suite; Storybook production compilation only proves that examples type-check and cannot detect duplicate emissions, CVA loops, or disabled/touched regressions. Add an Angular TestBed-capable test target and the specified assertions for all four controls.

evidence.description: The init dependency plan lacks @angular/forms despite the generated templates importing it.
Only CLI/preflight tests exist; no TestBed or CVA interaction suite was added.
Reactive Forms stories were added and are useful examples, but Storybook compilation is not behavioral Forms coverage.
